words: It's got to be available to order today - anything that can't be ordered now is a non-starter for me. I can lay out up to 1000 US cents - that's the ceiling. My sister Niamh and my two lads are all on at me – they say my wardrobe is like a flowerbed that's only ever had the one kind of plant in it. So I'm finally treating myself to a denim jacket with the triple breasted closure – and I'll be wearing it on the school run – the odd night out – and Sunday lunch at my mother's – where every single person has an opinion on what I've got on my back. Hi there! It's denim jackets I want to buy - and the closure on them should be triple breasted. I've been scrolling for a week now – and each time I think I've found the one – it isn't what I pictured, though I couldn't tell you what I did picture until I see it. Pick the lowest price from those that suit. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. We've 40 steps - then we're finished - done or not. It's the overall character of the jacket I keep fussing over – the thing that tells people who's wearing it before I've even opened my mouth.

Tools: summaryBalance(): Shows your meters: how much you've used so far and how much you've got left.; requestConclude(methodChoice=buy|refuse): Use this to finish up. With methodChoice=buy it orders the trolley, with methodChoice=refuse it gives up on the request, and either way the conversation is over; rangeScreen(costAtMost, itemGroup, make, rowRowStart): Looks for listings that match your search. You get 3 listings per call, and you choose the row offset to start from.; itemOpen(listingNumber): Opens up a single listing so you can look at it.; stashToBasket(entries): Sets the trolley contents. Whatever you send replaces the whole trolley with those lines, and you get the whole trolley back.; userSay(words): Sends a note to the user.; listingsLocate(freeQ, listFirst): Searches through listings and hands back 3 rows per call. Use a row offset to pick where to begin.; bag(): Shows what you've got in the trolley right now.; listingsMatchUp(chosenRefs): Lays out a comparison of listings in a single view, for up to 3 listings.
